scope: Israeli motorcycle/scooter importer source systems + manufacturer owner-manual systems (Yamaha, Honda, SYM, Kymco, Piaggio/Vespa, Suzuki, Kawasaki, BMW Motorrad, KTM, Harley-Davidson, Zontes, Voge, CFMOTO)
method: curl (--ssl-no-revoke, browser UA), WebFetch, WebSearch. Read-only. No login, no click-through acceptance, no plate numbers, no personal-data forms. Three PDFs were downloaded only to confirm document structure (not transcribed) and deleted.
dimensionRules: ALLOWED only with explicit evidence (robots.txt counts only for discovery/fetch). NOT_ALLOWED only on explicit prohibition or access control. 'Without prior written permission' => REQUIRES_PERMISSION. Unaddressed => UNKNOWN.

sourceSystems.robots: yamaha-motor.co.il and sanyang.co.il: 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /*?=search, /login, /personal-area/ / Allow: /'; ai.txt adds Crawl-delay: 5. metro.co.il: Allow / except /wishlist.

automatedFetchAllowed.evidence: Same ai.txt permission to scan ('מותר לסרוק'), with Crawl-delay: 5. kawasaki.co.il blocks plain clients technically.

automatedExtractionAllowed.evidence: Conflict. ai.txt allows analysis 'לצורך למידה או ציטוט, תוך ייחוס', but the Terms say 'המשתמש מצהיר כי השימוש בתוכן האתר הוא לצרכיו הפרטיים שלו בלבד.' — https://www.yamaha-motor.co.il/page/תנאי-שימוש (200)

documentCachingAllowed.evidence: The Terms ban copying only 'לצורך הפצה ו/או פרסום' without written approval, and limit use to private needs. Internal caching is not addressed explicitly.

documentRedistributionAllowed.evidence: 'לא יפרסם ברבים את המידע ו/או כל חלק הימנו, ללא אישור, מראש ובכתב' and 'לא ישכפל ו/או יצלם ו/או יעתיק … לצורך הפצה ו/או פרסום … ללא אישורם המוקדם ובכתב' — https://www.sanyang.co.il/page/תנאי-שימוש (200)

notes: Prior research re-verified: SYM (robots allow-all, sitemap, manual PDFs with a Periodical Maintenance Schedule chapter, no terms page) is confirmed. Correction: only about 1/3 of SYM model pages carry a manual; JET 14 (non-EVO) is not listed anywhere on sym-global.com; the manuals state no model year. The Yamaha library terms (copy/modify/distribute without permission prohibited; 'I agree' checkbox) are confirmed. The Honda MOTOPUB licence quote is confirmed, and the Israel region MCT exists with a Hebrew licence.

New finding: Ofer Avnir (the importer for KYMCO, Piaggio, Vespa, Suzuki moto and CFMOTO) publishes Hebrew owner manuals ('ספר רכב') per model. A sampled KYMCO manual has a 'לוח זמנים של תחזוקה' section. Discovery uses admin-ajax.php, which robots.txt disallows (/wp-admin/), and terms clause 32 requires prior written consent for any commercial use or copying.
New finding: KTM exposes a public JSON manual index with model + year + market. This is the best deterministic applicability found, but ktm.com legal notices prohibit commercial use or duplication.
New finding: BMW Motorrad Israel (Delek Motors) lists per-series maintenance-plan PDFs, but the links require Microsoft login.

New finding: Metro Motor's yamaha-motor.co.il and sanyang.co.il publish ai.txt files that explicitly permit AI scanning/analysis for learning/citation with attribution. Their Terms of Use conflict: private use only, no public republication without written approval. Metro publishes no manuals.
Kawasaki PWS (pws.ktivs.net) auto-creates a guest user on first visit. No further interaction was made.
No Israeli importer publishes a public maintenance-schedule web page (type A). The only type-B Israeli source is Ofer Avnir. All others are D.
Downloaded PDFs (Ofer Avnir Downtown 350i, SYM JETX and Joyride, and a Metro dealer-agreement PDF used only for importer evidence) were deleted. No schedule contents were transcribed.
Transparency: two POST calls to oferavnir admin-ajax.php (choose_book, choose_model) were made to verify the response shape. That path is robots-disallowed. They sent no personal data.
